reviewMethod: Independent visual inspection of all 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 37–72, including every model, alternative proof, diagram, scale, component allocation and detailed credit note. All 43 question and 43 solution crops inspected.
sourceNotes: 43 independently practicable tasks and 43 scales; Q5A and Q5B both retained. All sections, including old-syllabus Section C, use the Paper 2 modern scales.
Ten starred tasks only: Q2(b)(iii), Q7(b,c,d), all six Q8 tasks. Q6(b)(ii) is binary 5A; Q5B is 25C with awards 0/8/17/25.
Q3(b) requires two methods under one 5B scale; Q3(c) is one open application. All four model solution methods retained.
Q6(c)(ii) retains the complete A–E response list; D full credit and B/C partial credit. This is an answer-selection task, not five optional prompts.

Full source tables, graphs, measurement grids and diagrams travel with dependent tasks. Q8(b)(i) preserves credit for measurements shown in part (ii). Original-scale source access retained for constructions, pie chart and offsets.
